firmware.title: Sega Genesis
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; Gwenesis by bzhxx
firmware.description: A Sega Genesis / Mega Drive on Gwenesis, with YM2612 FM sound, 3- and 6-button pads and save states. ROMs load from the SD card.
firmware.controls: NES/SNES/USB pad or keyboard (arrows, A/S/D, Enter). Select+Start or Esc: settings.
